Swiss Army Bench 0.0.16: Install on the Extensions page downloads the extension itself.

- **Extensions install reliably:** Install (and an update that keeps your extensions) now downloads the extension's
  wheel from this version's GitHub release itself, then hands uv the file. In 0.0.15 uv fetched it and could be
  refused by GitHub's download link on some networks; the app then came back without the extension and said
  nothing. A download that fails is now said plainly and the app starts again as it was.

Update from the tray (right-click, Update to 0.0.16), or:

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
